title: You Don’t Believe in God Either — Let’s Be Honest

top_liked.author: @matthewthompson0
top_liked.text: I don’t know if this will resonate with anyone, but I’ve been into tarot and manifestation for a while, trying to get my life to move forward. It just wasn’t happening. One day, a friend sent me a link to book How To Actually Attract by Rick Lewis and said check this out I…

top_liked.author: @rossthomas7886
top_liked.text: I honestly remember being about 6 years old and going to church with my mother and thinking “This is nonsense”. I kept that to myself, I felt guilty about it, but I was never a believer.

top_liked.author: @ericb9804
top_liked.text: Damn.  I'm ready to drag my kid out of bed, put on my best shirt and listen to this man every Sunday morning.

top_liked.author: @Milani2588
top_liked.text: "You don't have to fear hell to be a good person" is absolutely spot on! I've rarely seen fellow black atheists on social media. It's hard being an atheist, especially in the black community.

top_liked.author: @RedAngelSophia
top_liked.text: When I believed in God, I DID feel devastating heartbreak at His refusal to either free me from certain desires or make it possible for me to attain those desires. That is why when I deconverted, it felt like a huge weight off my shoulder. Certain things in life sucked — but the…

top_liked.text: I had to ask myself as a child, "will I ever have the kind of faith that can move mountains?" My answer ultimately was always, no. It took me a while to understand that faith was worthless for everyone.
